lines.text: The Reubenites and Gadites, who had large herds, ask Moses to give them the land of Jazer and Gilead instead of crossing the Jordan.
Moses reminds them that their fathers discouraged Israel at the Valley of Eshcol, so the LORD made Israel wander forty years.
The LORD swore that only Caleb son of Jephunneh and Aaron son of Nun would see the land.
Moses says that if every armed man crosses the Jordan, they may return, but otherwise their sin will find them out.
Moses gave the Gadites, Reubenites and half-tribe of Manasseh the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Moab.
